Army Rescues 11 Civilians, Including Children, in Rajouri Floods

The Indian Army, in coordination with SDRF and police, conducted successful rescue operations in Rajouri following heavy rains and flash floods. Eleven civilians, including five children, were saved from the swollen Tawi river in separate operations in Thanmandi and Naushera. The rescues highlight the challenges posed by severe weather events in the region.
